# st-zentao_system (Resource)

Manages a ZenTao application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "st-zentao_system" "example" {
  product = 1 # owning product id; changing it replaces the application
  name    = "Back Office"
  desc    = "Created by Terraform"
  status  = "active" # active | inactive
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application display name.
- `product` (Number) Owning product id. Changing it forces resource replacement.

### Optional

- `desc` (String) Description.
- `status` (String) Enabled state. One of: "active", "inactive".

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) Account that created the application.
- `created_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Numeric ZenTao application ID.
- `integrated` (Number) Whether the application aggregates child applications (1) or not (0).
- `last_edited_by` (String) Account of the last edit.
- `last_edited_date` (String) Last edit timestamp.
